itemRef.description: An AT-URI + CID pointer to a catalog record. The AT-URI's own collection segment already identifies what kind of record this points to (at://did/{collection}/rkey), so no separate type field is stored. NOTE: structurally identical to #ref since variants were removed -- the two are kept separate only because existing records reference both; they are candidates to collapse.

payment.description: Which payment system a receipt was settled through, plus its opaque reference in that system. Grouped because neither field means anything alone -- ref is only interpretable relative to processor.

ref.description: Stripe PaymentIntent ID or equivalent. Independently verifiable via the payment processor.
A plain AT-URI + CID pointer to another record -- e.g. purchase.receipt's listing, licenseGrant, and grantedItems entries. NOTE: structurally identical to #itemRef; see that definition.
